answers:
The IBM Watson® Assistant service is an installable tool that combines machine learning, natural language understanding, and integrated dialog tools to create conversation flows between your applications and users. You can use IBM Watson® Assistant within the IBM Cloud Pak® for Data to build a branded assistant that can be integrated into any device, application, or channel. This assistant can connect with the customer engagement resources you already use, providing an engaging and unified problem-solving experience for your customers.
By utilizing AI-driven conversational flows, your assistant harnesses industry-leading AI capabilities to understand the questions your customers ask in natural language. With IBM Watson® Assistant, you can create your own branded live chatbot, also known as an assistant, that can be deployed across various devices, applications, or channels. This chatbot effectively connects to your existing customer engagement resources, ensuring a cohesive and engaging problem-solving experience for your customers.

Watson Assistant 

The installable IBM Watson® Assistant service combines machine learning, natural language understanding, and integrated dialog tools to create conversation flows between your apps and your users. For more information about this service, see [IBM Watson® Assistant](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/assistant?topic=assistant-getting-started).

The Watson packages are deprecated. Please use the [Watson SDKs](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/watson?topic=watson-using-sdks) to perform Watson related functionality. For more information about which Watson SDK is included in the available runtimes, see the [Functions runtime](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/openwhisk?topic=openwhisk-runtimes) documentation.

The Watson Assistant package contains the following entities. For more information, see the [Watson Assistant API reference](https://cloud.ibm.com/apidocs/assistant-v1introduction).



Table 1. Watson assistant package entities

 Entity Type Parameters Description

This documentation describes installed instances of Watson Assistant. For more information about using a managed instance in IBM Cloud or in Cloud Pak for Data as a Service, see [this documentation](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/watson-assistant?topic=watson-assistant-welcome-new-assistant).



 Feature availability 

Watson Assistant can be deployed as a managed cloud service or can be installed on premises. This documentation describes how to use the product installed on premises with IBM Cloud Pak® for Data. Some features that are available with Watson Assistant for cloud are not available with Watson Assistant for IBM Cloud Pak® for Data.

The following features are not available with Watson Assistant for IBM Cloud Pak® for Data:



* Third party channel support, for example, Slack, Facebook, SMS, and WhatsApp
* Service desk support, for example, Salesforce and Zendesk
* Voice Integration







 How it works

About Watson Assistant 

Use IBM Watson® Assistant to build your own branded live chatbot into any device, application, or channel. Your chatbot, which is also known as an assistant, connects to the customer engagement resources you already use to deliver an engaging, unified problem-solving experience to your customers.
